misprints.note: A Roman capital I is printed instead of the digit 1 for the first sense number of Ställe.
Omicron with grave accent is printed for alpha.
Rough breathing with circumflex is printed, and no iota subscript is visible.
The word is printed with ο for α.
A doubled full stop is printed before the colon.
The genitive ending carries a smooth breathing instead of a plain acute.

misprints.printed: ngn till glädje, ἐμποιεῖν l. παρέχειν τινὶ λύπην
misprints.note: The Swedish says 'glädje' (joy) but the Greek means grief. Possibly an editorial slip; kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The punctuation is a full stop followed by a single raised dot, perhaps a broken colon. Transcribed as '.:'.
The mark over ω could be a rough breathing alone or a rough breathing with acute. Transcribed as ὡς. The same applies to 'οὐχ ὡς' in 0431_04.
The breathing over ω is small and hard to tell apart. Read as rough with circumflex.
